results.description:
Let the MILLION-COPY BESTSELLING author Jo Bartlett sweep you away with her BRAND NEW heartwarming and absorbing read

Thirteen years ago, Iris’s life was shattered when her father’s sudden death revealed a devastating secret, making her doubt everything she believed to be true.

Now working as a researcher, Iris relies on solid facts. She’s built a wall round her emotions, unable to trust herself when it comes to love, or letting people in. But then she returns to her Cornish hometown to consult on a TV series for scriptwriter Declan Fitzgerald.

Single father Declan is charming, clever and devoted to his eight-year-old daughter, Mabel. Iris is undeniably drawn to him, and forms an instant friendship with the little girl. But her deep-seated trust issues, combined with local gossip claiming that Declan was involved in his wife’s disappearance, push Iris to dig deep into his past and the unsolved case.

The tangle of secrets she uncovers – and Declan’s reaction – threatens to destroy the fragile bond building between them.

Can Iris finally let go of the betrayal that defined her past and trust her gut, or will she lose the love – and family – she has always longed for?

An emotional and uplifting story of love, secrets and found family — perfect for fans of Veronica Henry, Sarah Morgan and Cathy Bramley.

Praise for Jo Bartlett:

'Stunning setting, wonderful characters, and oozing with warmth. A triumph from Jo Bartlett.' Bestselling author, Jessica Redland

'Perfectly written and set in the beating heart of a community, this story is a wonderful slice of Cornish escapism.' Bestselling author, Helen J Rolfe

'Jo writes from the heart, infusing her novels with real-life experiences. You feel like a part of the community or family in every one of her stories.' Reader Review

'I was drawn in from the first word, I’ve laughed and cried, what a really lovely story' Reader Review

'I would highly recommend this book for a bit of fantastic escapism and love conquering all.'Reader Review

'It made me laugh, hold my breath and want to cry. A wonderful story of family and guilt and in the end love brings it all together in the right way.'Reader Review

'What a gem of a book. Family drama at its best.' Reader Review
